planets.name: TOI-5388 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-5388 with a 2.59-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-5388 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-5388. Its orbit and size follow Poultourtzidis et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
